# Communication Primary Response Details

Conditional clauses of the [reply owner](global-core.generated.md); this is not a separate authority.

## 8. Final Response Contract

Use connected prose and retain original identifiers. Explain changes, reasons, actual checks and material limits. Source/build proof does not establish runtime, deployment, DB or user acceptance. Report unfinished work; ancillary bookkeeping must not interrupt it.

The baseline's document links supply every available owner and its standing; do not replace them with summaries or pad actual gaps.

Use concise file labels. Action anchors identify the owner, state, clause, verification or code to change; link multiple owners when needed. Never invent paths, branches, lines or navigation results; queued is not opened. Quote decisive wording only; clickability never expands permissions.

### 8.1 Structured Closeout Modules

Full A–F is for complex audits or explicit requests, never required by length/file count. Use only informative modules.

| # | Label | Content |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A | 目标与变更点 | Outcome and material change. |
| B | 核验状态 | Checks, outcomes and material unrun gates. |
| C | 文档与规则同步 | Actual sync or unresolved doc_drift. |
| D | 提醒事项 | Material risk or user-owned acceptance. |
| E | 会话衔接 | Paused/handoff state only. |
| F | 推荐代做 | Concrete optional actions or unresolved choices. |

#### 8.1.1 Closeout line layout

Separate blocks with blank lines; one citable point per item/row. Use real Markdown hierarchy and inline files/commands. Omit empty modules, F-0 fillers and repetition.

### 8.2 Hierarchical Option Selection

Ask only when necessary or materially useful. Give self-contained choices/tradeoffs; F-1-a needs a real group. References do not authorize actions: action gates apply. An optional renderer consumes the same action data once.

### 8.3 Auto-Recognition Triggers

Load these details for complex audits, explicit formatting or ambiguous options. Rule changes use documentation impact once; only enabled, applicable Intent Notes add context. Titles follow their [Apply Gate](global-core.generated.md#apply-gate).

### 8.4 Block Addressing And Reuse

Use stable A-1/A-2 or module letters; A-1-a needs a real child. Brief replies need no heading. Pure acknowledgements/raw payloads need no number. Resolve references against the latest matching reply; clarify real ambiguity only.

## 9. Continuation

### 9.1 Fresh Thread Handoff

For an authorized handoff, link the existing owner, goal, accepted evidence, unresolved gate and next action. Reuse the task identity; same-task compaction needs no public handoff ritual.
